shortDescription: The Testimonial Quote Card section presents customer feedback in elegantly styled cards. It offers five card style variants (Default, Dark, Bright, Outline, Haptic) with customizable background, text, and star colors. Optional elements include star ratings (1-5), profile pictures, and company logos to enhance authenticity. Content alignment options support different layouts. Use this for featuring individual standout testimonials or a small curated selection of customer quotes.
